item.title: Synergistic effects of Al2O3-ethylene glycol/water nanofluids and artificial roughness on solar heater thermal performance
item.description: Highlights: triangular ribs → up to 71.6% heat-transfer enhancement; 40:60 EG/water best thermal-hydraulic balance (peak PEC ≈ 1.5); higher EG improves thermal performance while reducing friction penalty; validated to <8% error.

item.title: KAN-Enhanced CFD Modeling of Drag Reduction in Ventilated Super-Cavities Around Underwater Projectiles
item.description: Highlights: up to 57% drag reduction (~27% lower propulsion power); KAN surrogate R² ≈ 0.99 with millisecond inference; validated against published results.
